units.source_text: 却说源氏公子当晚在纪伊守家里，辗转不能成眠，说道：

en.t: Now Prince Genji spent that night at the governor of Kii's house, tossing and turning unable to sleep, and said:

units.source_text: “我从未受人如此嫌恶，今夜方知人世之痛苦，仔细想来，好不羞耻！

en.t: "Never before have I been so hated by someone. Tonight I have finally learned the pain of this world; when I think it over carefully, how shameful it is!
I no longer want to go on living!"

units.source_text: 小君默默无言，只是泪流满面，蜷伏在公子身旁。

en.t: Kogimi said nothing, only wept until his face was covered with tears, and curled up beside the prince.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得他的样子非常可爱。

en.t: Prince Genji found the boy's appearance very endearing.

units.source_text: 他想：“那天晚上我暗中摸索到的空蝉的小巧身材，

en.t: He thought, "That night, in the dark, the small figure of Utsusemi that I felt by touch,

units.source_text: 和不很长的头发，样子正和这小君相似。

en.t: and her not very long hair, looked just like this Kogimi.

units.source_text: 这也许是心理作用，总之，十分可爱。

en.t: Perhaps this is only my imagination; in any case, it is very charming.

units.source_text: 我对她无理强求，追踪搜索，实在太过分了；

en.t: I was unreasonable in forcing myself on her and pursuing her everywhere; I truly went too far.
But her coldness is truly frightening too!"
He kept thinking it over until dawn.

units.source_text: 也不像往日那样仔细吩咐，就在天色未亮之时匆匆离去，

en.t: Without giving careful instructions as he usually did, he hurried away before the sky had grown light,

units.source_text: 使小君觉得又是伤心，又是无聊。

en.t: leaving Kogimi feeling both sad and forlorn.
